transit.title:
Drive from Asahikawa,
one hill in Sorachi.
transit.lead: This is not a walk-from-the-station hill. Base yourself in Asahikawa. The usual drive is the Do-o Expressway toward Sunagawa SA smart IC. JR Sunagawa or Akabira plus taxi or a rental car.
specs: ~70 min by car from central Asahikawa
~15 min from Sunagawa SA smart IC
transit.imgAlt: Kamoidake base and center house from Route 1027

highlights.title: Ski the east. Treat the west as extra.

primary.title: Lifts 1 and 2 are the operating core
primary.lead: Official current copy is the east area. Lift 1 (1,002 m) to the summit, Lift 2 (584 m) on the lower east. Bambi 600 m 12–18°, Course 1 1,400 m max 27°, race course 1,200 m 17–29°, training burn, Course 2.
primary.imgAlt: East face, Lift 1, summit radio tower

secondary.title: West powder is a separate ticket
secondary.lead: West opens when snowpack allows. Extra west-area ticket. Lift 3 does not run. Climb on East Lift 1. Return on the free shuttle when west is open.

pass.title: Adult day ticket ¥6,000.
pass.lead: Official 25–26 guide: residents adult day ¥6,000, tourist ¥8,000, junior high ¥3,000, elementary ¥2,300. A Hokkaido-resident day rate also exists. No night-skiing ticket.
pass.noticeBody: Prices follow the official table. Season and multi-ride tickets exist. Sold on center-house floor 2.
pass.imgAlt: Kamoidake lift tickets and center house

rental.title:
Rental desk,
center house floor 2.
rental.lead: Ski and board sets are issued at the same floor as tickets. This is not a no-rental town-park model.
rental.whisper: Sizes and stock: check on site or the official site.
rental.imgAlt: Rental desk on center house floor 2

yukinko.title:
Daytime only.
No night skiing listed.
yukinko.lead: Lifts 9:00–15:30. Lift 2 until 15:00. This hill is not sold as a floodlit night venue.
yukinko.whisper: Closures and opening days: official blog and live camera.
yukinko.imgAlt: East area and Lift 1 in daylight

workation.title:
Asahikawa as hub,
one day out.
workation.lead: Leave Asahikawa in the morning, ski Sorachi, come down before last lift, then the lodge or back to the hub. Not a station-walk itinerary.

01.title: Asahikawa Airport / city
01.body: Rental car. Skyticket from Asahikawa Airport

02.title: Do-o Expwy toward Sunagawa
02.body: Sunagawa SA smart IC is the near ramp

03.title: Base on Route 1027
03.body: Tickets and rental at the center house

04.title: East area
04.body: Lifts 1 and 2. West is extra ticket, snow-dependent

05.title: Unkai-no-Sato or Asahikawa
05.body: Lodge next door, or dinner back at the hub

family.title:
Start on Bambi,
not the race pitch.
family.lead: The mountain is not 100% beginner. The gentle run is Bambi (600 m, 12–18°). The race course is 17–29°. Families should look at Lift 2 and Bambi first.
specs: Cafeteria and rest in the center house
family.noticeBody: The training burn and race course may close or stay ungroomed for training.

spa.title:
After skiing,
the lodge next door.
spa.lead: Unkai-no-Sato Kamoidake sits beside the hill: Finnish sauna and large bath.
spa.whisper: Day-use bathing hours: check the lodge site.
spa.imgAlt: Snow around the center house and adjacent lodge

local.title: A Sorachi race hill, east-first for now
local.body: Kamoidake in Utashinai is a known Sorachi race hill. Public ops today are the two east lifts.

schools.title: Race course and training burn
schools.body: The 17–29° race course and a training burn whose grooming changes by day. Gates can close them. First snow only: start on Bambi.

summer.title: West is a separate ticket
summer.body: West powder waits for snowpack. Extra entry. Lift 3 does not run. Climb on East Lift 1; return by shuttle.
